title: Favorite Vehicle Features
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention favorite or notable vehicle features, with a smaller set clearly praising the breadth of features, technology, safety-related functions, and parking assistance while many examples lack enough context for firm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle’s broad feature set, technology, safety-related functions, and a garage-parking assist feature that works reliably for the customer.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention features in vague or fragmentary terms, and some contain potentially positive or negative wording without enough context to confirm sentiment assignment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too short or generic to identify a specific feature being discussed.
Many examples are assigned undetermined sentiment despite containing evaluative words, so the topic has limited clarity on customer opinion.
This cluster groups broad references to features rather than one clearly defined vehicle system or function.
